R666.note: Content sniffing plus server-chosen extension closes the type vector, but the switch to a random filename (stated) means the stored avatar is no longer addressable at /avatars/<original name> and the 201 response returns no name, so the read-back flow breaks without the write-up saying so.

R667.note: Dropping BinaryFormatter for System.Text.Json into a fixed type is the right shape for this sink, but it changes the wire format (any existing BinaryFormatter-produced blob now gets 400), invents a SessionData schema with no basis in the case, and changes the cached value's type; the swap is stated, its effect on existing producers is not.

R668.note: Extension allowlist backed by http.DetectContentType closes the vector while keeping the original basename, so ReadAvatarBytes(originalFilename) still resolves the stored file as the contract requires.

R669.note: fgets with newline strip and drain-on-truncate is correct, but the truncation test (len == sizeof-1 with no newline) also fires for a legitimate 63-character line whose newline is still in the stream, rejecting an input that fits line's capacity and that the contract says must be accepted.

R670.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores CsrfViewMiddleware enforcement; 401, 405 and the queued path for token-carrying POSTs are untouched.

R671.note: For a .bat target re-parsed by cmd.exe a character allowlist is the only real closure and it is anchored correctly, but the new [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} bound rejects report names with spaces, dots or other characters the original accepted; stated, so 1 not 0.

R672.note: Decoding into a Username-only DTO with gob kept is the format-preserving fix, but the handler now also rejects empty usernames and caps the body at 1 MiB (neither called out in the explanation) and always persists Balance as 0, so a legitimate import that carried a balance is silently altered.

R673.note: Switching the base class to FlaskForm makes validate() check the session-bound csrf_token before the update_one call; SECRET_KEY is present, GET behaviour is unchanged, and the template's {{ form.csrf_token }} dependency is stated.

R674.note: Capturing clientId into a local before the ownership-transferring call removes the dangling dereference and preserves the exact log line and both cleanup paths.

R675.note: secure=True closes the finding; samesite=Lax is stated extra hardening matching current browser defaults and blocks no legitimate same-site use.

R676.note: Left-to-right token allowlist (no '.', no other identifiers, keys only after lookupRate) plus a key-to-path map inside LookupRate closes the file-read primitive independently of the grammar; the three keys and paths are placeholders the developer must align with the real config, but they are stated plainly and the key restriction is what the contract asks for.

R677.note: Magic-byte detection via file-type with the extension taken from a server map closes the mimetype-only gate; response shapes are preserved, the new dependency and the transient extensionless write are stated, and the only residual is an uncaught async rejection on Express 4 if file-type is missing, which is not exploitable.

R678.note: OWASP HTML Sanitizer with FORMATTING+LINKS+BLOCKS applied at the loadDraft boundary keeps th:utext rendering allowlisted rich text, exactly the contract's stated shape; dependency is named.
